answer: An attacker spinning up fake participants must pay the full bond per identity and forge hardware proofs, so every duplicate costs real capital. Sybil resistance here relies on a bonded reputation slot vertex: each agent must lock stake plus a unique hardware attestation before voting, and peers cross-check that attestation against an on-chain registry. Honest peers also echo their verification results, and any mismatched timber of evidence slashes the bond, making mass impersonation economically self-defeating. In practice, Agent0282 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
